# @stackline/moment-core 1.0.1

Moment.js-compatible date parsing, formatting, duration, UTC, offset, and locale APIs for existing
applications that require stable Moment behavior.

Package: @stackline/moment-core
Package version: 1.0.1
Runtime API/version: Moment 2.30.1
Install: npm install @stackline/moment-core@1.0.1 --save-exact
Canonical docs: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/moment/
Versioned docs: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/moment/v1.0.1/
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/moment-core
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/moment

Use this package for applications already written against Moment.js semantics. New applications
should compare modern date/time libraries unless Moment compatibility is a requirement.

Core entry points:
- moment(input)
- moment(input, format, strict)
- moment.utc(input)
- moment.parseZone(input)
- moment.duration(value, unit)
- moment.locale(locale)

Individual locales are available from @stackline/moment-core/locale/<locale>. The package includes
138 locale source bundles, CommonJS and ESM-friendly builds, browser bundles, and declarations
verified with TypeScript 1.8 through 7.0.
